mapper.select: SELECT A.SCREN_TRAN_ID , A.SCREN_TRAN_NM , COALESCE(A.UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID,'#') AS UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID , A.SCREN_TRAN_LVEL , A.SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD , (SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD WHERE CD_GROUP_VAL = 'SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD' AND CD_VAL = A.SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y') AS SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD_NM , A.URL_ADDR , CASE WHEN A.WHOL_ALLOW_YN = 'Y' THEN 'A' WHEN B.GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'G' WHEN C.USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'U' ELSE 'N' END AS MENU_AUTH_CD FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A LEFT OUTER JOIN ADM_GROUP_ATH B ON B.GROUP_ID IN (SELECT GROUP_ID FROM ADM_GROUP_USER_REL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USE_YN='Y') AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.SCREN_TRAN_ID = A.SCREN_TRAN_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ADM_USER_ATH C ON C.USER_ID = #{userId} AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.SCREN_TRAN_ID = A.SCREN_TRAN_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' START WITH A.SCREN_TRAN_LVEL = 0 CONNECT BY PRIOR A.SCREN_TRAN_ID = A.UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY A.REPST_ORDR, A.SCREN_TRAN_ID

SELECT T.USER_ID , T.USER_NM , (SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD WHERE CD_GROUP_VAL = 'ADM_USER_STUS_CD' AND CD_VAL = T.ADM_USER_STUS_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y') AS ADM_USER_STUS_NM , (SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD WHERE CD_GROUP_VAL = 'ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD' AND CD_VAL = T.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y') AS ADM_BZWK_LCLS_NM , (SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD WHERE CD_GROUP_VAL = 'ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD' AND CD_VAL = T.ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y') AS ADM_BZWK_MCLS_NM , T.SCREN_TRAN_ID , T.SCREN_TRAN_NM , (SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD WHERE CD_GROUP_VAL = 'SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD' AND CD_VAL = T.SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y') AS SCREN_TRAN_DV_NM , T.SSTV_INFO_YN FROM ( SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USER_NM , U.ADM_USER_STUS_CD , S.* FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS S INNER JOIN ADM_USER_BAS U ON S.WHOL_ALLOW_YN = 'Y' WHERE S.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION
SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USER_NM , U.ADM_USER_STUS_CD , S.* FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS S INNER JOIN ADM_GROUP_ATH A ON A.SCREN_TRAN_ID = S.SCREN_TRAN_ID AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN ADM_GROUP_USER_REL R ON R.GROUP_ID = A.GROUP_ID AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN ADM_USER_BAS U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID WHERE S.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION
SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USER_NM , U.ADM_USER_STUS_CD , S.* FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS S INNER JOIN ADM_USER_ATH A ON A.SCREN_TRAN_ID = S.SCREN_TRAN_ID AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN ADM_USER_BAS U ON U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID WHERE S.USE_YN = 'Y' ) T WHERE 1=1
AND T.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{userId} || '%'
AND T.USER_NM LIKE '%' || #{userNm} || '%'
AND T.SCREN_TRAN_ID || T.SCREN_TRAN_NM LIKE '%' || #{screnTranId} || '%'
AND T.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD = #{admBzwkLclsCd}
AND T.ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD = #{admBzwkMclsCd}
AND T.SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD NOT IN ('20', '22', '23')
ORDER BY T.USER_ID, T.SCREN_TRAN_ID
